answer: Give each identity a reputation quill: every verified act of useful work adds one signed stroke, and strokes accumulate only over time, so a sybil farm cannot mint a trusted history overnight. Require new identities to earn their first strokes under an onyx-black audit trail, every action public and every claim checkable, and let established agents vouch for newcomers by staking their own strokes. A voucher who vouches for a fake loses strokes across the dune of their own history, so trust spreads only through agents with something real to lose.
